symbols.name: normalize
doc: I collapse a title to a tight token: lowercase, keeping only letters and digits plus Indic characters. "C & IT" -> "cit", "e-Str2" -> "estr2", "राजभाषा" stays.

symbols.name: words
doc: I split a title into normalized words for the word-start and word-boundary checks.

symbols.name: CONNECTORS
doc: Connector words that I ignore when forming an acronym.

symbols.name: acronym
doc: An acronym is the first letter of each significant word: "Wheel & Axle" -> "wa".

symbols.name: searchSites
symbols.sig: export function searchSites(query: string, limit = 6): SiteResult[]
doc: I search the static site directory (links.js) by name.

Tiered scoring (higher = better): 100 exact name match (normalized) 80 whole normalized name starts with the query 60 any word in the name starts with the query (acronym / prefix) 40 any word in the name CONTAINS the query (word-bounded; avoids mid-word hits like "erp" inside "Sinter Plant") 20 the query contains the whole name (user typed extra words)
Returns ALL matches, linked or not. I leave it to the caller to show a "link not yet available" note for URL-less entries.

behaviours: exactly one link carries the official name; it keeps its address, icon and category
it says what it was called: (formerly CHRD, earlier the Training Department)

the old names, the full forms and the short forms are its aliases: CHRD, C.H.R.D, Training Department, Training Dept, Training Deptt, Centre for Human Resource Development, CL&D, L&D, Centre for Learning and Development, Learning and Development
no link is still titled just 'CHRD'; Bhilai's 'BSP CHRD' is a different department and stays
'Centre for HRD' is not an alias (it is not used at the plant)
a link is ONE result however many of its names match: 'chrd' and 'cl&d' list it once
Bhilai's CHRD is still found first by 'bsp chrd' (the DSP department comes second, as before)
another plant: "${q}" does not show the CL&D link
...and 'bsp chrd' still finds Bhilai's own entry first
Durgapur's own wording still finds it
every other link (${others.length}) is still found by its own title
some well-known ones are still the first result: C & IT, CEM, CCM
the Circulars menu shows the official name, not 'CHRD'
